title: Appeal
text: 1.12 Appeal An applicant, who is not satisfied with decision taken to suspend or cancel Status Certificate, may file an appeal to DGFT within 45 days. Decision of DGFT shall be final and binding thereon. pg. 9 pg. 9 A reasonable opportunity shall be given to Status Holder before taking any action under this paragraph.
